question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

solution:
Thee logic followed here is:

When a mirror is placed vertically to the object, the mirror image will be laterally inverted. In other words, **Left Hand Side** and** Right Hand Side** will interchange their positions, while top and bottom remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b683cf8ffc7ab9007fb07e9a596cd362e04c19a44f4a22666ca954e12f0af3a9.png]
